_how_sampled: scripts/trial_isoeffect_sweep.py JUDGE_SEED=20930; the pool is sorted by PMID BEFORE shuffling so the draw depends on the seed and not on census shard order; 16 drawn from the equivalence arm and 10 from the difference arm.
_label_limit: `reported_verdict` adjudicates the OUTCOME LABEL, not the arm extraction. Most rows are `unclear` because an abstract often does not state the primary comparison plainly enough to confirm or refute the regex. That is why the report quotes NO classifier precision: a figure computed over a majority of unadjudicable rows would describe my reading rather than the classifier.
_limit: Judged from ABSTRACTS, not full papers. An arm stated only in the methods of the full text cannot be checked here, so this bounds abstract-level extraction and not trial-level truth.
_what: Hand-judged sample behind the extraction-precision figure in analysis/trial-isoeffect-sweep.md (#930). Judged by reading each record's own abstract against the arms the extractor returned.
